findings.claim: Production grammar remains b:<uuid>:<field> with aimlBlockId attribute ownership.
Supported adapters are seven F14 leaves; no container adapters registered.
core/list has no adapter; core/list-item does. Structural containers have no adapters.
core/navigation, core/query, and core/block appear in DYNAMIC_BLOCK_NAMES.
Research fixtures cover structural, textual, media, and shared/dynamic families.
